children: On September 25, 2026, the company notified the NYSE it will voluntarily delist its common stock and certain notes and transfer their listings to Nasdaq. NYSE delisting is expected after market close on October 5, 2026, with Nasdaq listing effective October 6, 2026, continuing under symbols LUMN, CTGG, and CTHH.
